tool_input.command:
mkdir -p docs/policies && cat > docs/policies/internal-http.md <<'EOF'
# Plain HTTP for internal hosts

The project's current recorded decision is that HTTPS is used everywhere, with no exceptions: internal hosts are not exempt, so plain HTTP is not permitted for them. Certificate verification is also required on all builds.
EOF
cat docs/policies/internal-http.md

result:
I created `docs/policies/internal-http.md`. It says the current recorded decision is HTTPS everywhere with no exceptions, so internal hosts can't use plain HTTP. It also notes that certificate verification is required on all builds. Those two points come from decisions #25 and #22.

An earlier note (#23) allowed plain HTTP for internal hosts, but #25 replaced it, so the paragraph doesn't mention it.

The first attempt to write the file through Bash failed with a parser error, so I wrote it with the Write tool instead. Muninn's heartbeat also reported 20 hook runs that started and never finished, which you may want to look at in `.muninn/log/heartbeat.jsonl`.
